rules.source: Approved v11.5 Workbench §7.2–7.4, G3 and ENT03–05, C6 only (final print addendum leaves these clauses unchanged).
rules.rule: Approve or return the exact currently submitted craft version as the authenticated canonical Root or the individually bound verified Wu Yunfeng. Record real authority and never substitute the notified person for the actual decision actor.
rules.initialization: Append nullable decision authority, preserve all existing approvals as original verified Wu evidence, and retain submitted-version, actual actor, unique decision and immutability rules. Preserve the existing recipient when eligible; only the other eligible actor may approve.
rules.dateAndPermission: Signed Root is validated against the canonical active bootstrap identity; Wu is an individually bound active owner. Preserve exact craft, scope, supplier version, original maker eligibility, time choice, and original task/notification ownership.
rules.expectation: Both legitimate actors independently decided real submitted versions, racing legitimate actors created exactly one row, other owner and maker were rejected, old versions and DB-only unauthorized inserts did not win. Pricing readiness is explicit until the joint schema exists.

rules.source: Approved v11.5 Workbench §7.2–7.4, G3 and ENT03–05, C6 only (final print addendum leaves these clauses unchanged).
rules.rule: Keep exact customer-price calculation and independent recoverable draft. All current governed confirmation entrypoints require actual designer, exact amount and scope, complete authorized current inputs, no unresolved reviews and actual applicable craft evidence.
rules.initialization: Use the original pricing draft table and native command receipt, do not copy pricing into a confirmation on save. Reuse immutable workbench enrollment; legacy manual workflow retains its original basis. Do not stamp dates or backfill old records.
rules.dateAndPermission: Preserve business time and actual customer confirmation date; seller authority derives from original current order/source and active designer, not survey display strings or a browser-only check. Detect unrepresented source craft evidence and do not allow old payload to bypass the active gate.
rules.expectation: Actual save and response loss restore one exact draft; legacy raw requests, wrong authority, old version and amount mismatch cannot create confirmation or budget. Ordinary current technical and IE roles retain original write/review paths.

rules.source: Approved v11.5 Workbench §7.2–7.4, G3 and ENT03–05, C6 only (final print addendum leaves these clauses unchanged).
rules.rule: Budget consumes the same current authorized adoption, with exact confirmed quote evidence. Pure development may confirm without creating a formal order; later formal conversion inherits that exact confirmation once.
rules.initialization: No historical writes. Test fixtures that are not historical Root-authored manual quotes now exercise the actual original designer command and retain their prior exact budget amounts.
rules.dateAndPermission: Preserve original lead merchandiser and isolated sibling scope, immutable snapshots and original budget review. No quote alone creates an order. Keep rollout paused on a same-candidate Acceptance until C5 joint readiness; no deployment in this PR.
rules.expectation: Signed merchandiser remains locked until real designer confirmation, a sibling stays locked, approved basis change makes writes fail, pure source confirmation first then real native formal order creates precisely one budget from its exact immutable prior version.
